card.subject: check-branch-collision refuses every push from a card worktree, because it reads the checked-out branch and finds Hydrostat's own claim ref
card.activeForm: Teaching check-branch-collision about pushed refs and Hydrostat claims

work_items: Card #22: make check-branch-collision judge the refs being pushed, not the checked-out branch
runConfiguration.backwards_compatibility: Keep the manual run working: ./scripts/check-branch-collision.sh with no pre-push context still checks the checked-out branch.

card.description: Found by card #17 on 2026-10-14. scripts/check-branch-collision.sh (pre-push stage) takes BRANCH from git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD and refuses when origin has that branch with no PR. In a card worktree the checked-out branch is card-<id>, and origin/card-<id> always exists as Hydrostat's claim ref with no PR, so every push from a card worktree is refused as an orphan, including a refspec push to a different remote branch (git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/card-17-frontend-ci). The hook never reads the pushed refs, which git supplies on the pre-push hook's stdin. Card #17 worked around it with a temporary worktree checked out on the target branch name. Fix: read local_ref remote_ref pairs from stdin and check each remote_ref; treat refs/heads/card-<n> claim refs as known. Decision: the hook reads PRE_COMMIT_REMOTE_BRANCH, not stdin. pre-commit (4.5.1 measured, pre_commit/commands/hook_impl.py _pre_push_ns) consumes git's pre-push stdin and exports the first ref carrying commits the remote lacks, so stdin is empty by the time the script runs. A manual run still judges the checked-out branch. card-<n> passes as a claim ref, and the remote lookup matches refs/heads/<branch> exactly.

status.summary: scripts/check-branch-collision.sh judges the pushed ref from PRE_COMMIT_REMOTE_BRANCH, falls back to the checked-out branch on a manual run, passes card-<n> claim refs and tags, and matches refs/heads/<branch> exactly. tests/unit/scripts/test_check_branch_collision.py: 9 tests on real git against a scratch bare origin with gh stubbed, one of them a real git push through real pre-commit using the repo's own hook definition. Mutant: 8 of 9 fail against the original script; the passing one is the manual run on an orphan, the behaviour kept by the operator's backwards_compatibility answer.

for_the_board: Remove card #22 from goal.json's priority order and READY list. Pushes from a card worktree to any non-orphan branch now pass check-branch-collision; the temporary-worktree workaround card #17 used is no longer needed.

The root checkout's .venv has pre-commit 4.5.1 while requirements-dev.txt and requirements-ci.txt pin 4.6.2. Host venv drift, not a repo defect; a pip install -r requirements-dev.txt in the root checkout repairs it.
A global improve drop was filed: pre-commit's pre-push stage hides git's stdin from hooks and exports PRE_COMMIT_REMOTE_BRANCH for one ref only.
